entities.name: Roman Catholic Diocese of Parma
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Diocese of Parma is a Latin diocese of the Catholic Church. It has properly been called Diocese of Parma-Fontevivo since 1892. The bishop's seat is in Parma Cathedral. The diocese is a suffragan of the Archdiocese of Modena-Nonantola.
